notes: Historical financials are mapped as: revenue = 'Sales' (Total company sales) and EBIT = 'Operating profit' from Kroger’s results press release tables; FY2025 operating profit includes significant impairment charges for the automated fulfillment network. ([ir.kroger.com](https://ir.kroger.com/news/news-details/2026/Kroger-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results-andAnnounces-Guidance-for-2026/default.aspx))

D&A equals 'Depreciation and amortization' from Kroger consolidated cash flow tables; capex equals 'Payments for property and equipment, including payments for lease buyouts' (cash flow line; modeled as positive absolute investment outflow). ([ir.kroger.com](https://ir.kroger.com/news/news-details/2026/Kroger-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results-andAnnounces-Guidance-for-2026/default.aspx))

NWC construction (non-standard, explicitly defined): NWC = (Total current assets − cash − temporary cash investments) − (Total current liabilities − current portion of long-term debt under finance leases − current portion of operating lease liabilities). This results in negative NWC for all three historical years. ([ir.kroger.com](https://ir.kroger.com/news/news-details/2026/Kroger-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results-andAnnounces-Guidance-for-2026/default.aspx))
WACC is a modeling assumption (0.085) rather than directly stated in company filings; update if you have a sourced WACC methodology for your pipeline.
NOL balance and minority interest/preferred equity were not extracted from the provided press-release tables in this run; set to null and flagged here for follow-up from the latest 10-K footnotes.
Comps forward multiples (EV/NTM revenue, EV/NTM EBITDA, P/E NTM) were not captured from a single primary/high-quality market-data feed in this run; comps numeric fields are null by design.

catalysts: Progress toward eCommerce profitability targets and operational improvements highlighted in FY2025 results commentary. ([ir.kroger.com](https://ir.kroger.com/news/news-details/2026/Kroger-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results-andAnnounces-Guidance-for-2026/default.aspx))

Delivery on FY2026 guidance for operating profitability and cash generation, including capex discipline. ([ir.kroger.com](https://ir.kroger.com/news/news-details/2026/Kroger-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results-andAnnounces-Guidance-for-2026/default.aspx))

Continued share repurchases as authorized by the board (incremental capital return can affect per-share value). ([ir.kroger.com](https://ir.kroger.com/news/news-details/2026/Kroger-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results-andAnnounces-Guidance-for-2026/default.aspx))
company_overview: Kroger is a leading U.S. grocery retailer with an eCommerce and store experience across multiple banner names, serving over 11 million customers daily. ([ir.kroger.com](https://ir.kroger.com/news/news-details/2026/Kroger-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results-andAnnounces-Guidance-for-2026/default.aspx))

Kroger operates across food retail with additional alternative/adjacent profit businesses and a pharmacy-driven customer base. ([ir.kroger.com](https://ir.kroger.com/news/news-details/2026/Kroger-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results-andAnnounces-Guidance-for-2026/default.aspx))

The company reports results using a fiscal year that ended January 31, 2026 for FY2025 in its latest annual results release. ([ir.kroger.com](https://ir.kroger.com/news/news-details/2026/Kroger-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results-andAnnounces-Guidance-for-2026/default.aspx))
current_context: FY2025 total company sales were $147.6B and operating profit was $1.9B, which includes $2.5B of previously announced impairment charges for the automated fulfillment network. ([ir.kroger.com](https://ir.kroger.com/news/news-details/2026/Kroger-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results-andAnnounces-Guidance-for-2026/default.aspx))

FY2026 guidance includes identical sales without fuel growth of 1.0% to 2.0%, adjusted FIFO operating profit of $5.0B to $5.2B, and capex of $3.8B to $4.0B. ([ir.kroger.com](https://ir.kroger.com/news/news-details/2026/Kroger-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results-andAnnounces-Guidance-for-2026/default.aspx))

Kroger’s FY2026 guidance also presents an adjusted tax rate of 23% for modeling. ([ir.kroger.com](https://ir.kroger.com/news/news-details/2026/Kroger-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results-andAnnounces-Guidance-for-2026/default.aspx))
investment_highlights: Base case assumes low-single-digit revenue growth consistent with Kroger’s guided identical sales range and the business’s mature grocery footprint. ([ir.kroger.com](https://ir.kroger.com/news/news-details/2026/Kroger-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results-andAnnounces-Guidance-for-2026/default.aspx))

Base case EBIT margin normalization after FY2025 impairment, with gradual improvement toward a ~2.6% target as the core cost/mix profile stabilizes. ([ir.kroger.com](https://ir.kroger.com/news/news-details/2026/Kroger-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results-andAnnounces-Guidance-for-2026/default.aspx))

Reinvestment intensity is held near historical capex levels as a percent of sales (supported by FY2024–FY2025 cash flow disclosures and FY2026 capex guidance). ([ir.kroger.com](https://ir.kroger.com/news/news-details/2025/Kroger-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2024-Results-Announces-Guidance-for-2025/default.aspx?ftag=MSFd61514f))

Working capital is modeled as persistently negative (supplier-funded model), supporting free-cash-flow generation. ([ir.kroger.com](https://ir.kroger.com/news/news-details/2026/Kroger-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results-andAnnounces-Guidance-for-2026/default.aspx))

eCommerce execution remains a key operating lever; FY2026 planning references eCommerce profitability progress as part of the value creation model. ([ir.kroger.com](https://ir.kroger.com/news/news-details/2026/Kroger-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results-andAnnounces-Guidance-for-2026/default.aspx))
key_risks: Further disruptions or impairments related to fulfillment and retail automation/technology execution. ([ir.kroger.com](https://ir.kroger.com/news/news-details/2026/Kroger-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results-andAnnounces-Guidance-for-2026/default.aspx))
Margin pressure from competitive pricing, labor cost inflation, and input cost variability (especially given grocery’s low spread structure).
Working capital deterioration (less negative NWC) would reduce free cash flow versus the model’s supplier-funded assumption.

presentation.subtitle: DCF Valuation Inputs — The Kroger Co. (KR)
valuation_summary: DCF uses a Gordon-growth terminal framework with a 2.0% long-run growth assumption and a WACC input of 8.5% to reflect a mature U.S. retailer risk profile (modeling assumption).

Forecast drivers are anchored to FY2023–FY2025 history for revenue growth, D&A intensity, and capex intensity, with only gradual margin recovery in the base case. ([ir.kroger.com](https://ir.kroger.com/news/news-details/2025/Kroger-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2024-Results-Announces-Guidance-for-2025/default.aspx?ftag=MSFd61514f))
Comps section is included for completeness, but forward EV/NTM revenue, EV/NTM EBITDA, and P/E NTM were not reliably captured from a single primary/high-quality feed in this run (left as null).
